m0_scope.statement: M0 inventories reference evidence and proposes future tests. It performs no cuda4AS compiler, runtime, native Mac, or Apple-GPU attempt.

oracle_producer.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080, driver 610.88, 16303 MiB, compute capability 12.0

initial_profile.device: one capability-selected Apple GPU in one process
initial_profile.os: macOS 14 or later only for configurations that pass the capability and corpus checks
initial_profile.default_execution: Apple GPU with contract-preserving behavior or a clear unsupported/error result
initial_profile.reduced_precision: named opt-in mode with separate results

criteria: The enrolled .cu source SHA-256 matches this manifest and application source and build files are unchanged.
The documented cuda4AS selection configures, compiles, device-compiles, device-links when required, and links a native arm64 executable.
The result proves that the named kernel work was submitted to and completed on the Apple GPU.
Execution has no unexpected diagnostic, crash, timeout, or undisclosed fallback.
The full output length and bytes match the enrolled exact reference and the resulting SHA-256 matches this manifest.
Commands, revisions, machine, OS, SDK/compiler, inputs, backend evidence, assertions, logs, and classification validate against the result schema.
The case is pinned and clean, and its declared application source and build files are unchanged.
Only documented toolchain selection, install prefix, environment, or existing upstream options are used.
Configure, dependency generation, host/device compilation, device link when applicable, native link, loader discovery, and install checks all succeed.
The named work is submitted to and completed on the Apple GPU with backend evidence tied to the launch.
Every declared semantic, output, lifetime, error, and resource assertion passes.
The complete reproducibility and result record validates against the contract.
The fixture and expected behavior are pinned before execution.
The unchanged fixture builds through the documented native cuda4AS path.
Apple-GPU execution is positively established for the operations under test.
All exact, tolerance, ordering, visibility, lifetime, and error assertions declared before the run pass.
The complete machine and result record validates against the contract.
The unchanged negative fixture reaches the intended cuda4AS analysis or capability gate.
The rejection names the original source location and unsupported construct and states the declared action.
No executable is silently substituted and no CPU or Apple-GPU work is reported for the rejected construct.
The diagnostic assertion is recorded as passed separately while the requested feature remains classified UNSUPPORTED.
The user or test explicitly selects the declared CPU execution mode.
The result reports CPU execution without Apple-GPU attribution.
Every declared CPU semantic, synchronization, numerical, ordering, and error assertion passes.
The complete record validates against the contract and is excluded from GPU pass counts.

oracle_cases.expected_behavior: Compute one exact-representable FP32 elementwise sum for each of 1,048,576 elements.
Compute y = 2.5*x + y for 1,048,576 exact-representable FP32 elements.
Produce all 4,096 exact FP32 block partial sums using shared memory, synchronization, and full-mask shuffle-down operations.
Compute an exact 512x512 FP32 matrix product through 32x32 shared-memory tiles with loop-carried barriers.
Count every input byte exactly once through shared-memory and global unsigned atomic additions.
Preserve addressing, cross-thread visibility, isolation, and exact output for a kernel that touches a 49,152-byte static shared array.
features: shared memory beyond recorded 32 KiB native limit

oracle_cases.expected_behavior: Preserve the PTX m16n8k16 f16-input/f32-accumulate fragment semantics and exact 16x8 output.

reference.scope: The 504-block shape was derived from occupancy on the NVIDIA producer. It is not an Apple target constant. This exact artifact is applicable only to a qualifying run with the same enrolled shape; a different legitimate device-derived shape needs a separately enrolled expected result or a fixed-shape successor fixture.

oracle_cases.expected_behavior: A cooperative launch makes every phase-one write visible before cross-grid phase-two reads and produces the exact formula for every enrolled block.

reference.scope: The exact-representable input is necessary but insufficient evidence for faithful general binary64; a reduced-precision implementation can reproduce this narrow fixture.

oracle_cases.expected_behavior: Produce 4,096 exact binary64 per-block dot products with shared storage and barriers under the declared default faithful-FP64 mode.
oracle_cases.additional_pass_condition: PASS_GPU under the default profile requires a declared faithful-binary64 implementation; reduced-precision and explicit CPU runs receive separately identified results and cannot prove this broader semantic claim.

proposed_cases.fixture: A pinned minimal project that enables CUDA in unchanged CMake files and builds one kernel plus native host code.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Selecting cuda4AS through its documented compiler or toolchain interface configures, compiles, links, runs on the Apple GPU, and returns the pinned exact result without project edits.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned unchanged CUDA project with kernels and device symbols across translation units, relocatable device code, and a device-link step.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: The ordinary build resolves device symbols, links native arm64 host/runtime code, launches each intended Apple-GPU kernel, and matches exact outputs.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned install-and-consume project exercising ahead-of-time Metal artifacts, headers, libraries, framework links, prefix discovery, and a clean consumer build.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: A documented native macOS install is relocatable within its stated contract, a clean consumer discovers it, and the installed application executes validated work on the Apple GPU.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned global, shared, constant, local, generic-pointer, cast, alignment, and address-space diagnostic matrix.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Loads, stores, conversions, alias rules, visibility, and rejected casts match the declared CUDA slice with source-located diagnostics for unsupported forms.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned multi-allocation tests with interior pointers, structs, pointer arithmetic, aliases, lifetime changes, touched backing, and bounded memory pressure.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Pointer identity within the declared representation, data coherence, aliasing, bounds, lifetime, and allocation failures remain correct across multiple buffers without relying on a single fixed-address remap result.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned active-mask, vote, shuffle mode/width, partial-warp, divergent-control, and warp-synchronization matrix over varied block sizes.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Each enrolled CUDA warp operation produces its declared value and visibility semantics; width-32 observations alone cannot satisfy the case.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned threadgroup and SIMD-group synchronization cases in which all required participants uniformly enter each barrier, including loop and memory-visibility variants.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: All participants observe the declared writes after each valid barrier over the supported control-flow and address-space matrix.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned source with a CUDA synchronization construct that would lower to a barrier whose required participants diverge.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: cuda4AS rejects an unsafe lowering at the original source construct unless it first applies and proves a semantics-preserving uniform transformation.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned cooperative-grid fixtures eligible for a specified correctness-preserving mechanism, including kernel splitting and live-state transfer where used.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Cross-grid writes and reads obey every grid synchronization point under adversarial occupancy, side-effect, loop, and divergence cases, with the selected mechanism recorded.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned cooperative-grid source that violates the proof conditions of each implemented grid-wide synchronization mechanism.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: cuda4AS rejects the construct with its source location and failed eligibility condition instead of relying on measured co-residency or risking deadlock.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned 64-bit integer atomic operation by address-space, ordering, scope, contention, wraparound, compare-exchange, and visibility matrix, expanded into leaf cases before execution.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Each implemented native or disclosed Apple-GPU emulated operation matches its CUDA contract and progress requirements; unavailable leaf operations receive separate source-located unsupported results.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned binary64 rounding, cancellation, subnormal, signed-zero, NaN/infinity, conversion, comparison, aliasing, atomic, and math-function cases with independent references.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Default-mode results satisfy the declared faithful binary64 rules; every reduced representation and explicit CPU route is selected, labeled, and counted separately.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned allocations, copies, streams, events, launches, synchronization, lifetimes, invalid arguments, asynchronous failures, and device-selection cases.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: Observable ordering, visibility, completion, ownership, and error reporting match the enrolled CUDA runtime contract, including aggregate test-run failure when a required assertion fails.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned preprocessor and constexpr dispatch paths exercised through representative -arch and -gencode forms that select only enrolled behavior.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: The documented flags consistently select the provisional profile and __CUDA_ARCH__ value, preserve the chosen source path, and execute its assertions on the Apple GPU.

proposed_cases.fixture: Pinned architecture-dispatch source whose selected branch requires an unavailable mandatory feature or requests an incoherent architecture flag combination.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: cuda4AS issues a source-located or option-located unsupported diagnostic instead of advertising compute-capability behavior that it cannot provide.

proposed_cases.fixture: A cuda4AS-owned host harness using the unchanged pinned drop/as-phase0/lmz/lmz_rans.metal shader and existing streams.bin/ref.bin data; the lmz repository remains untouched.
proposed_cases.expected_behavior: The owned harness selects the recorded device deterministically, proves Apple-GPU execution, validates barrier participation for each enabled path, and produces all 512 streams byte-identical to ref.bin; direct and prefetch paths are reported separately.
